ambient: The water takes the weight of an arm you had forgotten about.
You cover a distance. It is not the distance you intended.
Something moves past at hip height and does not need explaining.
description: Chest deep in something the temperature of a body, walking to the far side of a room that has agreed to be a pool. Every step is a decision and then a wait. The wait is fine. You have plenty of it.
name: The Shallow End

looks: Exactly your own temperature, which is why you keep losing where it starts.
It resists in a friendly way, the way a crowd resists.
It has no surface anywhere you look directly.
objects.name: the water

looks: Where you are going. Not getting closer at a rate you could complain about.
There is a step up out of this, and a rail, and both are theoretical.
You have been most of the way there for some time now.
objects.name: the far side

weather: Warm and close and heavy with wet, and none of it is on your face.
